definitions.explanation: The branch of medicine dealing with surgical procedures. Also refers to the surgical department in a hospital.

examples.japanese: {外科|げか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I had surgery in the surgical department.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{外科|げか}⟦{医|い}→医：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: She wants to become a surgeon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{整形|せいけい}→整形：09493_seikei⟧{外科|げか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{診|み}てもらった→診る：09798_miru⟧。
examples.english: I had my knee examined at orthopedic surgery.

notes:
{外科|げか} refers to the branch of medicine dealing with surgical procedures, or the surgical department in a hospital. A compound of ⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (outer) + {科|か} (department/specialty).

TYPES:
- ⟦{整形|せいけい}→整形：09493_seikei⟧{外科|げか}: orthopedic surgery
- ⟦{脳|のう}→脳：03537_nou⟧{外科|げか}: neurosurgery
- ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧{外科|げか}: cardiac surgery
- ⟦{美容|びよう}→美容：00014_biyou⟧{外科|げか}: cosmetic surgery

COMPOUNDS:
- {外科|げか}⟦{医|い}→医：noentry⟧: surgeon
- {外科|げか}⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧: surgical operation

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{内科|ないか}→内科：04076_naika⟧ (internal medicine) is the non-surgical counterpart. Together, {外科|げか} and ⟦{内科|ないか}→内科：04076_naika⟧ form the two fundamental divisions of clinical medicine.
